title: poa pratensis var. paratunkensis
intro: Poa pratensis var. paratunkensis, commonly known as Sandberg Bluegrass, is a subspecies of the Poa pratensis species and is a type of perennial grass. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Sandberg Bluegrass include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
